fields.name: source
fields.description: Inherited upstream footprint source label; common labels include osm, ms and ours2.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Inherited upstream feature identifier, stored as a string.

fields.name: cx
fields.description: Inherited ownership longitude in degrees.

fields.name: cy
fields.description: Inherited ownership latitude in degrees.

fields.name: geometry
fields.description: USBF footprint geometry, WKB in EPSG:4326.

fields.name: usbf_id
fields.description: Identifier for the published feature. Its construction is recorded in source_identity_basis.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Original 0.02-degree ownership cell used to assign each feature to one publication tile.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two-letter assigned U.S. state or District of Columbia code.

fields.name: circle_gate_status
fields.description: Recorded external-reference confirmation outcome for a circular or elliptical candidate.

fields.name: geometry_fallback
fields.description: Whether a rejected geometry candidate was replaced by the source footprint.

fields.name: height_coverage_status
fields.description: Processing nDSM coverage category: complete, partial or missing.

fields.name: height_valid_fraction
fields.description: Fraction of original-footprint sampling pixels covered by valid processing nDSM, from 0 to 1.

fields.name: height_missing
fields.description: Whether no valid processing nDSM pixels were available in the original footprint.

fields.name: height_incomplete
fields.description: Whether processing nDSM coverage of the original footprint was incomplete.

fields.name: inference_input_mode
fields.description: Image/elevation input mode used for the feature, such as rgb_height, rgb_partial_height or rgb_only.

fields.name: original_geometry
fields.description: Original GBA footprint geometry, WKB in EPSG:4326, where recorded.

fields.name: modified
fields.description: Whether the footprint coordinate representation differs from the original GBA footprint, where recorded.

fields.name: processing_status
fields.description: Recorded footprint-processing outcome.

fields.name: possible_small_FP
fields.description: Potential small false-positive flag; flagged features remain in the dataset.

fields.name: decision
fields.description: Recorded footprint-selection or editing decision.

fields.name: shape_changed
fields.description: Adopted circular or elliptical replacement flag; ordinary boundary edits can have this set to false.

fields.name: hollow_cut
fields.description: Whether an interior opening was added to the footprint.

fields.name: added_area_m2
fields.description: Area added relative to the original GBA footprint, square metres, computed in EPSG:5070.

fields.name: removed_area_m2
fields.description: Area removed relative to the original GBA footprint, square metres, computed in EPSG:5070.

fields.name: modification_type
fields.description: Recorded edit category: unchanged, addition, removal, addition_and_removal, courtyard_opening, circle_or_ellipse or coordinate_only.

fields.name: update_date
fields.description: Recorded feature snapshot date.

fields.name: footprint_license
fields.description: License identifier for the footprint component; see LICENSES.md.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Inherited GBA building height in metres; upstream nulls and missing-value sentinels are retained.

fields.name: gba_var
fields.description: Inherited GBA var attribute; interpretation follows the upstream definition.

fields.name: height_license
fields.description: License identifier for the inherited height component; see LICENSES.md.

fields.name: source_generation
fields.description: Source snapshot identifier associated with this feature.

fields.name: source_identity_basis
fields.description: How the published feature identifier was constructed.

original_geometry: Original GBA WKB when available; unknown for legacy records
height: Inherited GBA height; original sentinels retained
variance: gba_var is the standardized inherited variance; legacy var remains available
missing_modern_attributes: null, not inferred false or zero
null_semantics: A null attribute means not recorded; it is distinct from false and zero.
